title: 皐月賞の後に・挑戦は終わらない！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio runs her heart out, but unfortunately, first place slips from her grasp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She is deeply saddened to know that she can no longer claim the title of Triple Crown champion like Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that even though she cannot stand beside Symboli Rudolf, she can still surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her resolve blazing anew, Tokai Teio immediately starts training for the Japanese Derby without even a day's rest.
